recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future FHIR-I decision changes canonical URL use in Reference.reference or version-specific canonical syntax.
issue_request: FHIR-16865 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 FHIR-I request to document that Reference.reference may use canonical URLs and local canonical-resolution mechanisms, but may not include the canonical |[version] suffix.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 13e9c9f10ce30f7a0c47c07652f32ece4bfd46b8 (svn revision 14234), which added canonical URL guidance and the no-|[version] note to source/references.html.
additional_context: Current source/references.html still carries the FHIR-16865 guidance. Later Applied issue FHIR-50120 and commit 2cb3c190d26fbaecd4081ed9c4ab97206844a40f added more detailed guidance that Reference.reference may carry a resolvable canonical URL and that neither Reference.reference nor Reference.identifier can convey the canonical pipe-version form. FHIR-I Madrid 2025 minutes support that later guidance; no direct FHIR-16865 Confluence reference or conflicting community evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The authoritative references page already satisfies the seed resolution, and later final context reinforces the same rule.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue added detailed guidance on canonical URLs in Reference.reference and Reference.identifier without changing the FHIR-16865 no-|[version] rule.
Related to version-specific reference mechanisms for transaction-created resource references/extensions, but it does not supersede this canonical URL guidance.
